title: Update Homebrew
description: Updates Homebrew formulae definitions, upgrades all outdated packages (including cask applications), and cleans up old versions.

versions.notes: Homebrew runs in the background, so the script stays responsive during long upgrades.
Errors show the command's own message instead of a generic exit status.
Rewritten as three steps: update, upgrade formulae and cask apps, then clean up old versions.
Command-line mode with a dry run, and a test script for automated checks.
First version. Updates and upgrades Homebrew using your shell profile.
